learned: 2026-10-17: ayrloom.com/pages/lab-tests loads a plain HTML table (apps/ayrloom_labtests/php/table.html) of ~1,900 reports (date, product, category, batch, link) on cdn.shopify.com; all ACT Laboratories (NY). Categories: vapes 518, edibles 496, beverages 342, pre-rolls 300, balms 146, tinctures 104.
notes: Link text is just 'view'; filenames are <LOT>_<Product>_<size>_-_ACT_Labs_-_EXP_<MMDDYY>-<LOT>.pdf (V0528-0.5_Pineapple_Express_0.5g_..., PR0160-T_Cereal_Milk_0.6g_..., G1012_Pillow_Talk_10mg_..., BEV0264_Yuzu_Citrus_10mg_...). Some tinctures use hyphens (T0099-THC-Everyday-450-150mg-Tincture-ACT-Labs-EXP-062626.pdf).
Lot prefixes name the category: V vape, PR pre-roll, G gummy, BEV beverage, T / WST tincture.
Hemp products for other states (H- lots, Trichome Analytical and Beak Skiff reports, THC0## CBD drinks) are skipped. Older vape reports are from DRS Testing.
